title: CIA official blocking transfer of a non-human craft between Lockheed and Bigelow

tellings.quote: Greenwald, who's director of science and technology of the CIA, who's blocking UFO transfer between Lockheed and Bigelow, which we just discussed with Lacatski.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Greenwald, whom he calls the CIA's director of science and technology, blocked the handover of a UFO between Lockheed, an aerospace company, and Bigelow, another company. Michels ties this to what he discussed with James Lacatski, a guest on his show. If true, it would mean a non-human craft is held by private companies and the spy agency controls who gets it.
